checks.description: The R03 start contract binds the exact local unpublished R02 closure commit and tree.
Every R03 schema byte is bound by path, size, and SHA-256.
Every reused fixture, catalog, generator, metric policy, and tolerance byte is bound exactly.
All eight whole-frame paths and two support stages occur exactly once in the frozen matrix.
Each implementation invokes its named Apple framework path or records not_observed; copy and placeholder substitutes fail.
Every whole-frame backend uses the R02 AppleUpscaleSession FIFO lifecycle and typed outcomes.
Every executed route produces its exact frozen output dimensions.
Every whole-frame output is 8-bit NV12 420v.
Every whole-frame output preserves SDR BT.709 primaries, transfer, matrix, video range, and left chroma siting.
Every outcome carries complete backend, revision, model or not-required, configuration, policy, fallback, and material-decision identity.
Frame order, PTS, and duration remain exact through each executed session.
The frozen media transaction preserves exact compressed audio identity.
The frozen media transaction preserves exact timed metadata identity.
Every media output is reopened and verified before atomic publication.
Every admitted input and produced output lifetime token is released exactly once.
No backend performs local substitution or unrecorded fallback.
Every measured quality, timing, and memory value is finite and valid for its metric domain.
Three executions of one backend-fixture identity produce one output hash, or the subject is not_observed.
CPU/GPU parity is measured only for an exact comparable contract; otherwise an explicit not_applicable or not_observed reason is recorded.
Observed ringing overshoot and undershoot satisfy the frozen 0.05 limits.
Each observed analytic route records all three preregistered edge profiles.
Observed chroma displacement satisfies the frozen 0.25-pixel limit.
Repeated identical frames remain identical within and across deterministic sessions.
Observed throughput is positive and source-bound; unavailable execution is not_observed without a performance claim.
Observed memory is finite and nonnegative; unavailable execution is not_observed without a resource claim.
Observed in-flight resources remain at or below three and return to the lifecycle bound.
Guided-filter and edge-preserve subjects remain support stages and cannot enter the primary selection pool.
Every frozen matrix subject receives exactly one qualified, restricted, diagnostic_only, rejected, or not_observed disposition.
Unavailable execution records not_observed and never fabricates support, quality, repeatability, or performance.
R01 diagnostic-only inventory records never infer R03 availability or qualification.
Dominance elimination uses only complete observed comparable metrics and never ranks not_observed subjects.
A default can be selected only from observed qualified primary candidates, ordered by wall time, memory, then stable backend ID.
Production continues to inject the unavailable upscaler service throughout local R03 implementation.
No timing or memory observation is represented as a product performance claim.
No fixture, source presence, conformance result, or not_observed disposition is represented as product quality qualification.

stop_rules.description: Stop if the exact R02 local closure commit or tree binding changes.
Stop if a schema, fixture, catalog, generator, metric policy, or tolerance binding changes after freeze.
Stop closure if any of the ten frozen matrix subjects is missing or duplicated.
Stop a subject if its implementation uses a copy, placeholder, synthetic substitute, or a framework different from its frozen identity.
Stop an executed subject on dimension, 420v, BT.709, range, or chroma-siting mismatch.
Stop an executed media path on frame order, timing, audio, metadata, reopen, or atomic-publication mismatch.
Stop on incomplete processing identity or any local unrecorded substitution.
Stop an observed subject on nonfinite values or failed repeatability.
Reject or restrict an observed subject that fails a frozen applicable floor; never relax a floor after seeing output.
Stop closure on resource lifetime, in-flight bound, or session lifecycle violation.
Stop an authorizing observed run if throughput or memory evidence is missing; not_observed remains permitted and nonauthorizing.
Stop if dominance or default selection includes incomplete, noncomparable, reference-only, support-stage, or not_observed subjects.
Stop any fabricated hardware, simulator, runtime-support, repeatability, performance, resource, or quality observation or claim.
Stop publication, acceptance, production enablement, Auto, holdout, claim, tag, or release action without separate direct authority.
